# Unicons line icons

The website uses the existing Unicons **3.0.6** glyphs by IconScout, hosted with
the site so navigation and other icons remain available when the external icon
service cannot be reached. No glyphs or fonts have been edited or upgraded.

- Original stylesheet: https://unicons.iconscout.com/release/v3.0.6/css/line.css
- Original fonts: https://unicons.iconscout.com/release/v3.0.6/fonts/line/
- Upstream version: https://github.com/Iconscout/unicons/tree/v3.0.6
- Upstream license: https://github.com/Iconscout/unicons/blob/v3.0.6/LICENSE
- License: Apache-2.0; the complete upstream text is included in `LICENSE.txt`.

The stylesheet keeps the original icon mappings and styling. Its font sources
have been changed to the included WOFF2 files; unused legacy font formats have
been omitted. Unicode ranges still let browsers request only the needed files.
